me.gallowsdove.foxymachines.utils

Class CompatUtils

  • java.lang.Object
    • me.gallowsdove.foxymachines.utils.CompatUtils

  • public final class CompatUtils
extends java.lang.Object
    Version-safety helpers so FoxyMachines loads + enables on legacy servers (1.8–1.13) without a NoSuchFieldError/NoClassDefFoundError from post-1.8 constants and APIs.

    Enchantments/potions/sounds are resolved by name through the fork's relocated XSeries wrappers, so a modern-only value that maps to nothing on the running server simply yields null/skips instead of referencing a constant that doesn't exist. Particle spawning and the custom-mob subsystem are gated behind runtime version checks and isolated in dedicated methods so the JVM never resolves the 1.9+ org.bukkit.Particle/boss-bar classes on older servers.
